//: Boss, not placed anywhere yet (debug spawn only). Placeholder stats: shock storm and an electric body for now; teleporting comes when it gets a level.
description: A beast the size of a car, shaped like a starved wolf with three heads, and a weathered wooden power pole rising out of its spine.  Black cables run from the cross-arms down into its fur, and current crawls between the insulators with a sound like a transformer about to blow, and the air around it smells of ozone.  It is never quite where you last looked.
